description: Verifies the integrity.payload_hash procedure in SPEC.md section 6.2: RFC 8785 canonicalization of the payload with attachments[].data and integrity.payload_hash excluded, then SHA-256 of the resulting UTF-8 bytes. Deliberately ASCII-only content -- it checks field-exclusion and key-sorting mechanics, not RFC 8785's Unicode/high-precision-number edge cases.
how_to_check: From input_payload, drop attachments[].data, and reduce integrity to only {algorithm, canonicalization} (drop payload_hash). RFC 8785-canonicalize the result -- it must match canonical_form_excluding_hash byte for byte. Take the SHA-256 of that string's UTF-8 bytes, format as lowercase hex, and confirm it equals payload_hash_sha256_hex, which is also input_payload.integrity.payload_hash itself here since this vector is a complete, self-consistent, valid payload.
